name: Build a reproducible workbook
short_description: Build a workbook that imports, validates, calculates, and summarises at least 100 rows reproducibly.
self_assessment: I can build a 100-row reproducible workbook without help and refresh it from changed source data.
description: Build a workbook that imports, validates, calculates, and summarises at least 100 rows reproducibly. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Refresh a summary after replacing source data
